subject: Waterfall
text: The Waterfall is located north up the river near Onrac.

evidence.quote:
travel north up the river near
Onrac. You'll eventuallly run into the Waterfall.

subject: Gas Dragon
text: Gas Dragons in the Waterfall have 352 HP, are weak against Ice, and possess a poison attack.

evidence.quote:
Beware the Gas
Dragons, 352 HP, weak vs. Ice, and has a nasty Poison attack.

subject: Robot
text: Talking to the robot in the Waterfall's treasure room yields the CUBE, which grants access to the Floating Castle.

evidence.quote:
The only treasure room has a robot, and six treasures. Talk to the robot,
and he'll give you a CUBE, and tell you to use it to gain access to the
Floating Castle.

subject: Treasure room
text: The treasure room in the Waterfall contains a Ribbon.

evidence.quote: The treasures include another Ribbon (equip it on someone else, fast!),

subject: Treasure room
text: The treasure room in the Waterfall contains a Wizard Staff, which casts CONF when used in battle.

evidence.quote:
a
Wizard Staff (casts CONF when used in battle, I'd sell it.),

subject: Treasure room
text: The treasure room in the Waterfall contains a Defense sword, which casts RUSE when used in battle.

evidence.quote:
and a Defense
sword (casts RUSE when used in battle. It's also a good weapon for a second
Knight, Ninja, or Red Wizard.).

subject: Dr. Unne
text: Giving the SLAB to Dr. Unne in Melmond teaches the party the language of Lefein.

evidence.quote:
head back to Melmond. Remember Dr. Unne?
Well, find him and give him the SLAB. He'll teach you the language of Lefein.

subject: Lefein citizen
text: Speaking to the people in Lefein will yield the CHIME, the key to the Mirage Tower.

evidence.quote:
After a long walk south to Lefein, and talk to
the people. They'll tell you of the Floating Castle, the Sky Warriors, and of
Tiamat. One will give you the CHIME, which is the key to the Mirage Tower.

subject: Secret White Magic Shop
text: A secret magic shop through a break in the western wall of Lefein sells the Level 8 White Magic spell LIF2.

evidence.quote:
A break in the western wall leads to two secret magic shops. They have only
one spell each: the Level 8 White Magic spell of LIF2 (buy it, if you have a
White Wizard),

subject: Secret Black Magic Shop
text: A secret magic shop through a break in the western wall of Lefein sells the Level 8 Black Magic spell NUKE.

evidence.quote:
and the Level 8 Black Magic spell of NUKE (buy it, if you have
a Black Wizard).

subject: Mirage Tower
text: The Mirage Tower is located in the desert encircled by a mountain range.

evidence.quote:
find a place to land your airship inside the mountain range
that encircles a huge desert. You'll find the Mirage Tower in the middle of
the desert

subject: Treasure room
text: Floor 1 of Mirage Tower contains the Aegis Shield, which is resistant to poison.

evidence.quote:
MT Floor 1: Simple. The Treasure room here contains the Aegis Shield (equip
on your Knight, resistant to poison),

subject: Treasure room
text: Floor 1 of Mirage Tower contains a Heal Helmet, which casts HEAL when used during battle.

evidence.quote:
and a Heal Helmet (casts HEAL when used
during battle.)

subject: Treasure room
text: Floor 2 of Mirage Tower contains Thor's Hammer, which casts LIT2 in battle.

evidence.quote:
MT Floor 2: A bit more elaborate, but just circle counterclockwise. The
treasure room contains Thor's Hammer (equip on White Wizard if you've got one,
otherwise, keep it. Casts LIT2 in battle),

subject: Treasure room
text: Floor 2 of Mirage Tower contains the Sun Sword.

evidence.quote:
Sun Sword (a bit better than
Defense for a second Knight, Ninja, or Red Wizard),

subject: Treasure room
text: Floor 2 of Mirage Tower contains the Dragon Armor.

evidence.quote:
and Dragon Armor
(just as good as Opal, but without the resistance to Lightning. Good for a
second Knight only.)

subject: Blue Dragon
text: The Blue Dragon on Floor 3 of Mirage Tower has 454 HP, is weak against Fire, and uses a THUNDER attack.

evidence.quote:
MT Floor 3: Straightfoward. Circle around, enter the room, battle a Blue
Dragon the minute you do (454 HP, weak vs. Fire, has a THUNDER attack).

subject: Transporter
text: Having the CUBE allows the party to use the transporter on Floor 3 of Mirage Tower to enter the Floating Castle.

evidence.quote:
If you
have the CUBE you can use the transporter to enter the Floating Castle.

subject: South branch
text: The down branch on Floor 1 of Floating Castle contains the Bane Sword, which casts BANE when used in battle.

evidence.quote:
FC Floor 1: You start in the center, and you've got four branches. The top
one leads to Floor 2, left leads to GP, down leads to the Bane Sword (casts
BANE when used in battle, keep if you wish),

subject: Right branch
text: The right branch on Floor 1 of Floating Castle contains another Heal Helmet, a ProRing, and some GP.

evidence.quote:
right leads to another Heal
Helmet, a ProRing, and some GP.

subject: Southwest branch
text: The southwest branch on Floor 2 of Floating Castle leads to ADAMANT, which can be given to the Dwarven Blacksmith to forge Xcalber.

evidence.quote:
FC Floor 2: You've got 8 branches this time, and you start at the top.
Southwest leads to ADAMANT (EXIT now and go to the Dwarven Blacksmith to get
Xcalber, the second most powerful sword in the game, usable only by a Knight.)

subject: Southwest branch
text: Floor 2 of Floating Castle contains the Black Shirt, which casts ICE2 when used in battle.

evidence.quote:
southwest leads to the Black Shirt (casts ICE2 when
used in battle),

subject: Southwest branch
text: Floor 2 of Floating Castle contains the White Shirt, which casts INV2 when used in battle.

evidence.quote: and the White Shirt (casts INV2 when used in battle.).

subject: West branch
text: The west branch on Floor 2 of Floating Castle contains a Ribbon and an Opal Shield.

evidence.quote: West leads to another Ribbon and another Opal Shield.

subject: East branch
text: Heading right on Floor 3 of Floating Castle leads to a treasure room with the ProCape.

evidence.quote:
Head right for a treasure room. One of the
treasures here is the ProCape. It's basically works like the ProRing, but it
counts as a shield, and a halfway decent one at that.

subject: West branch
text: The west branch on Floor 3 of Floating Castle leads to a treasure room containing a Katana and the way to Floor 4.

evidence.quote:
The West
branch leads to a treasure room with a Katana (Best sword for a Ninja) and to
Floor 4

subject: Floor 4 path
text: On Floor 4 of Floating Castle, taking any cardinal direction and turning down the second intersection leads to a teleporter.

evidence.quote:
FC Floor 4: There are some powerful enemies here. Walk left and take the
second intersection up until you reach a teleporter. Or walk down and take the
second intersection right until you reach a teleporter. Or, walk right and
take the second intersection down until you reach a teleporter.

subject: WarMech
text: WarMech on Floor 5 has 1000 HP, hits physically for up to 256 damage, uses NUCLEAR for up to 400 damage to all, and awards 32000 XP and GP.

evidence.quote:
the WarMech (1000 HP, has no
strengths or weaknesses, but can do up to 256 damage to one character with
a physical attack, and his NUCLEAR blast can do up to 400 damage to all
characters. If you can manage to defeat him (FAST, NUKE, FADE, some timely
CUR4, and some good physical attacks), you are very well rewarded: 32000 XP
and GP.

subject: Tiamat
text: Tiamat has 1000 HP, resists elementals, and is weak against BRAK and BANE attacks like the Bane Sword.

evidence.quote:
Tiamat, the Fiend of Wind, is the toughest of the Fiends. 1000 HP, and
strong against elementals. (Both NP and Ben Siron's guides claim that he is
also weak against BRAK and BANE. If you've got somebody with a Bane Sword that
isn't really helping the cause much, the go ahead and try, it does
occasionally work, but don't waste any spell charges on it.)

subject: Black Orb
text: Talking to Garland's Black Orb in the Temple of Fiends teleports the party 2000 years into the past.

evidence.quote:
When you're through
messing around, talk to Garland's Black Orb, and you'll be teleported to the
Temple of Fiends, 2000 years ago.

subject: Frost Dragon
text: Frost Dragons on Floor 1 of the Temple of Fiends appear in groups of 3 or 4 and use Frost.

evidence.quote:
Watch out for
the Frost Dragons, they come 3 or 4 at a time and will Frost you to death if
you're not careful.

subject: Phantom
text: Entering the central room on Floor 3 triggers a battle against the Phantom, who is undead.

evidence.quote:
Floor 3: Head for the central room. When you enter you'll fight the Phantom,
who's easily dispatched (he's undead, if that helps).

subject: Treasure chests
text: The two treasure chests on Floor 3 contain 45000 and 65000 GP.

evidence.quote:
The two treasure chests
are worth 45000 and 65000 GP.

subject: Stone plate
text: The Stone plate on Floor 3 of the Temple of Fiends requires the LUTE to pass.

evidence.quote:
Another Stone plate is here, but remember the
LUTE you've been carrying from the beginning?

subject: Lich
text: Lich guards the stairs on Basement 1 and is capable of casting NUKE.

evidence.quote:
Right before the stairs you'll run into your good pal Lich, the Earth Fiend.
Same tactics generally work, except he can use NUKE now.

subject: Basement 2
text: Another ProCape can be found by exploring Basement 2 of the Temple of Fiends.

evidence.quote:
Basement 2: This floor contains enemies from the Gurgu Volcano, just in
greater quantity. You can find another ProCape on this level, if you take the
time to explore.

subject: Kary
text: Kary is fought again near the exit stairs on Basement 2 of the Temple of Fiends.

evidence.quote:
Travel
to the right then take the exit and head south then left to the stairs to get
out. You'll fight Kary again before you leave.

subject: Kraken
text: Kraken is fought again on the way out of Basement 3 of the Temple of Fiends.

evidence.quote:
Basement 3: This floor contains enemies from the Sea Shrine, just in greater
quantity. Make your way south, and take out Kraken again on the way out.

subject: Southeastern room
text: A small room off the southeastern tail on Basement 4 contains the Masmune.

evidence.quote:
It's divided into four squares, with the southeastern one having a
'tail' which has a small room with the Masmune.

subject: Tiamat
text: Tiamat is fought in the northeastern square on Basement 4 of the Temple of Fiends.

evidence.quote:
When you've got it, head for the Northeastern square,
and say 'hola' (or 'adios' if you prefer) to Tiamat on the way down.

subject: Chaos
text: Chaos has 2000 HP, casts CUR4 as his fourth spell, and uses Crack, Inferno for up to 384 Fire damage, and Swirl for up to 256 physical damage.

evidence.quote:
At any rate, he has 2000 HP, resistance to everything, some killer magic
(including an annoying CUR4 which is his fourth regular spell he uses), some
killer attacks (Crack - Instant death to all warriors [ProRing, anyone?],
Inferno - Up to 384 points of Fire damage to all warriors [Ribbon or WALL],
Swirl - Up to 256 physical damage to all warriors... you get the idea.)

subject: Chaos
text: Nintendo Power recommends being at least Level 27 to fight Chaos, while the author recommends Level 35.

evidence.quote: NP recommends you be at least Level 27 to fight him. I recommend about 35.

subject: Sliding puzzle
text: Pressing A and B together 55 times while inside the sailing ship opens a sliding puzzle minigame.

evidence.quote:
get in
the sailing ship, press A and B together 55 times to play a sliding puzzle
game.

subject: Dragon Armour
text: Dragon Armour is reported to make its wearer resistant to Fire, Ice, and Lightning.

evidence.quote:
Dave Connoy reports that the Dragon Armour makes its wearer resistant to
Fire/Ice/Lightning.

subject: ARUB
text: ARUB displays a resist magic message and is reported to grant resistance to all magic.

evidence.quote:
Somebody reported that ARUB granted resistance to all magic, not just
instant-death spells. This was based on the fact that a "resist magic" message
pops up when you use it.
